message.content: {"caption":"Few-shot adaptation pipeline showing example grids transformed through self-editing and fine-tuning, then used to produce a checked evaluation output.","description":"A left-to-right process diagram titled “Few-Shot Setup,” divided into “Few-Shot Examples,” “Self-Edit (SE),” and “Evaluation.” The Few-Shot Examples section contains several paired examples of small blue and teal square grids. A right-pointing arrow carries these examples to a model box labeled “LM” with parameters θ_t. Two curved branches from the model point right to orange self-edit settings boxes. The first lists basic_augmentations: true; size_augmentations: false; chain_augmentations: false; repeat_augmentations: false. The second lists strategy: loss on all tokens; learning rate: 1e-05; epochs: 3. A right-pointing arrow from the settings leads to an “SFT” box. Above the fine-tuning expression is a bordered collection of small blue-and-teal grid examples; a downward arrow connects this collection to the loss expression. The expression shows a loss over grid data and θ_t, followed by a right-pointing arrow to updated parameters θ′_t. In Evaluation, a small blue-and-teal grid points right to an “LM” box labeled θ′_t, which points right to another small colored grid. A check mark above the output grid indicates a correct or successful result.","figure_type":"diagram","chart_values":[]}
